text:
The minimal rule translated cleanly into next-open mechanics but did not beat unconditional drift at any frozen hold. The 20-session sideways-versus-trending contrast deserves context because it is positive under both aggregation lenses, yet the positive-return condition itself underperforms sideways-state-only. The correct status is a transparent TRAIN stop before horizon selection or OOS—not an edge claim and not a dead-end verdict on all continuation ideas.
